bio: "An antelope is a document," says Madame Documentation.
name: Suzanne Briet

pieces.content:
Yes art should be like a dream, she said. But
the kind of dream where you are doing chores or,
better, inventing a new way to keep things tidy.
And no idea is inlaid, all clouds have pants,
you and I are especially alike.
pieces.readme: Two items: a simulation of Otlet writing Briet's name in a conveyer or canon loop; and a transcript of a discussion had with Suzanne Briet in the kitchen at a party.
pieces.title: Dream anteloping
